other_conditions: One parent (father or mother) must be registered as a beneficiary/construction worker for at least one year in the board
Beneficiary must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days during the year before the application date
A maximum of two daughters of the beneficiary (or the female beneficiary and her one daughter) are eligible for the incentive
The female beneficiary must be unmarried, or the daughter must be at least 18 years old and unmarried
The daughter must have passed at least the 8th standard
There must be a savings bank account in the name of the daughter
If the beneficiary owns a house, it must have a toilet
Beneficiary’s identity card must be valid/active at the time of application
Girls who have already received assistance under the Board’s Marriage Assistance Scheme are not eligible
Incentive amount is payable only after physical verification of the beneficiary’s status as a construction worker
Application must be submitted after completing one year as a registered beneficiary
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹55,000, directly transferred to the beneficiary’s bank account, to be used for higher education, vocational training, starting a business, skill development, or marriage expenses.
